title: Influence of stem undersizing during direct anterior approach for total hip arthroplasty on periprosthetic bone biomechanics: a finite element analysis
abstractText: Aims Stem undersizing during cementless total hip arthroplasty (THA) may occur more frequently when the procedure is performed through the direct anterior approach (DAA) because of limited femoral exposure. Insufficient stem–bone contact may compromise primary stability and alter load transfer in the proximal femur. The aim was to investigate the biomechanical effects of femoral stem undersizing on periprosthetic bone using finite element analysis. A secondary objective was to evaluate whether the presence of a femoral stem collar modifies these biomechanical effects. Methods Patient-specific finite element models of the full femur were generated from CT data. Eight finite element models were analyzed, combining four implantation configurations of the AMIStem-P designs (Adequate Fit, Adequate Fit–Collared, Undersized, and Undersized–Collared) with two cancellous bone density conditions, representing 100% and 90% cancellous bone density. A hip joint force representing the peak loading phase during normal walking/single-leg support was applied. Strain intensity in periprosthetic trabecular bone was assessed according to Frost’s mechanostat theory, and von Mises stress distribution in the femoral stem was evaluated. Results Stem undersizing markedly increased strain intensity in the periprosthetic trabecular bone and enlarged regions exceeding the mechanostat overload threshold (> 3,000 µε). Adequate stem–bone fit with cortical support substantially reduced the volume of overloaded bone tissue. The presence of a collar reduced strain levels, particularly in undersized configurations, indicating improved proximal load transfer. Reduced cancellous bone density resulted in a moderate additional increase in strain. Simulated load reduction markedly decreased periprosthetic strain levels. Implant stresses remained well below material limits. Conclusion Femoral stem undersizing may substantially increase strain within the periprosthetic trabecular bone and enlarge regions exposed to overload conditions. Achieving adequate stem–bone fit with cortical support was associated with a marked reduction in periprosthetic bone strain. The presence of a collar appeared to partially mitigate the adverse mechanical effects of undersizing by improving proximal load transfer. Cite this article: Bone Joint Res 2026;15(11):1354–1363.

title: Estudios Sociales e Historia en acción: propuesta didáctica para fortalecer el pensamiento crítico mediante las corrientes filosóficas
abstractText: La enseñanza de Estudios Sociales e Historia enfrenta el desafío de superar la memorización de contenidos y promover aprendizajes que permitan interpretar los procesos históricos, sociales y filosóficos desde situaciones de la vida real. En este contexto, el estudio tuvo como objetivo general diseñar una propuesta didáctica basada en el análisis contextualizado y colaborativo de las corrientes filosóficas para fortalecer el pensamiento crítico de los estudiantes de una unidad educativa particular de Durán. Se desarrolló una investigación de enfoque cualitativo, tipo aplicada y alcance descriptivo-interpretativo, sustentada en el método de investigación-acción educativa. Se emplearon la observación pedagógica, el análisis documental y la valoración del producto estudiantil mediante una guía de observación, una matriz bibliográfica y una rúbrica analítica. Los resultados evidenciaron dificultades iniciales para evaluar fuentes, construir argumentos, comparar perspectivas y aplicar los conocimientos a problemas reales. La fundamentación pedagógica determinó que el neorrealismo facilitó el análisis de estructuras sociales y relaciones de poder; el neopositivismo favoreció la comprobación de evidencias; el vitalismo promovió la valoración integral de la vida; y el pragmatismo vinculó el conocimiento con la acción. La propuesta se organizó mediante investigación de fuentes, estudios de casos, debates, roles colaborativos, producción escrita y socialización de resultados. Como producto se obtuvo un trabajo académico estructurado sobre las cuatro corrientes filosóficas, cuya elaboración evidenció mejoras cualitativas en la organización de información, argumentación, cooperación y aplicación de conceptos. Se concluyó que la integración de filosofía, Estudios Sociales e Historia constituye una alternativa pertinente para fortalecer el pensamiento crítico, el aprendizaje contextualizado y la responsabilidad compartida.

Photothermal CO2 Hydrogenation to Multicarbon Products: Mechanisms, Catalyst Design, and Scale Demonstration
abstractText: Abstract Photothermal CO 2 hydrogenation to multicarbon products presents a promising route to mitigate global climate change while simultaneously generating valuable C 2+ products for industrial use. However, realizing high activity and selectivity toward multicarbon products remains a significant challenge, primarily due to the intricate nature of reactant activation and the inherently sluggish kinetics of C−C coupling. This review elucidates the fundamental principles of photothermal catalysis, with a particular focus on the synergistic interplay between light and thermal energy. In addition, the activation pathways of CO 2 to C 1 intermediates and the subsequent mechanisms of C−C bond formation leading to multicarbon products are systematically examined. On this basis, catalyst design and modification strategies are categorized to enhance reactant activation and facilitate efficient C−C coupling. Furthermore, recent progress in pilot-scale demonstrations is highlighted to showcase the potential for scalable and sustainable CO 2 hydrogenation technologies. By addressing the current challenges and outlining future research directions, this review aims to accelerate the development of efficient photothermal processes for CO 2 valorization.

title: A Molybdoenzyme Mediates Carbon–Sulfur Bond Making and Breaking in Ergothioneine Biosynthesis
abstractText: Abstract The molybdopterin-dependent ergothioneine synthase (MES) from Caldithrix abyssi is the first molybdoenzyme known to catalyze the formation of carbon–sulfur bonds. To complete its catalytic cycle, this bifunctional enzyme desulfurates l-cysteine at a pyridoxal 5′-phosphate binding site and transfers the harvested sulfur atom (S0) to the molybdenum center of a bis-molybdopterin guanine dinucleotide cofactor more than 50 Å away. Subsequently, the sulfurated Mo-center transfers the labile sulfur atom onto the imidazole ring of Nα-trimethyl histidine (TMH). Combining experimental observations from cryo-electron microscopy, X-ray crystallography, X-ray absorption spectroscopy, sequence-activity correlation, and substrate-specificity studies, we delineate the structural basis for long-distance sulfur transfer via a persulfide relay, the identity of the imidazole sulfurating species, and key sequence motifs that are indispensable for activity. Furthermore, the reversibility of MES-mediated sulfurization of TMH under physiological conditions suggests that ergothioneine may serve as a soluble reservoir of oxidizing equivalents, supporting anaerobic metabolism in deep-branching bacteria such as C. abyssi.

Dielectric gene engineering in subwavelength-structured amorphous silicon oxycarbide ceramic aerogels for programmable electromagnetic wave absorption
abstractText: Abstract Amorphous ceramics, distinctively represented by silicon oxycarbide (SiOC), are promising electromagnetic wave absorbers owing to their low density and high-temperature stability. To enable programmable attenuation, we propose a dielectric gene engineering strategy, fabricating subwavelength-structured amorphous SiOC aerogels via wet spinning, sol-gel processing, supercritical drying, and subsequent thermal treatments. At the macroscopic level, the customized multi-scale void network optimizes impedance matching, enhances multiple scattering and reflections, and effectively prolongs the propagation path of electromagnetic waves. At the microscale, intrinsic dielectric genes including the conductive sp2 carbon phase, dielectric SiC nanocrystals, asymmetric SiOxC4−x tetrahedra, and the interfaces of these heterogeneous nanodomains are established by manipulating carbothermal reduction and post-oxidation thermal etching. This engineered structural evolution achieves an optimal synergy among conduction loss from the carbon network, interfacial polarization at heterogeneous boundaries, and dipolar polarization induced by the asymmetric tetrahedra. Consequently, driven by this macro-micro synergy, these amorphous ceramic aerogels achieve programmable and frequency-tunable absorption spanning the C, X, and Ku bands. They deliver minimum reflection losses of –57.87 dB at 5.36 GHz, –70.09 dB at 9.04 GHz, and –54.06 dB at 14.28 GHz. This work demonstrates that integrating subwavelength architectures with dielectric gene engineering provides a paradigm for designing lightweight and frequency-programmable ceramic absorbers.

title: High-pressure phase transitions, electrical conductivity and recoverability of uranium polyhydrides
abstractText: Abstract The uranium-hydrogen system has been predicted to form numerous polyhydride compounds, exhibiting diverse physical properties. However, experiments report starkly conflicting results regarding synthesis pressures, stoichiometries, and stability, leaving their fundamental properties and even their existence uncertain. Through a series of laser-heated diamond anvil cell experiments, we systematically investigate the high-pressure phase diagram of the uranium-hydrogen system up to 99(3) GPa using synchrotron powder X-ray diffraction. Compression and laser heating of β -UH 3 at pressures of 41(1) and 91(3) GPa result in the formation of hcp -UH 7 and fcc -UH 8 , respectively. Upon decompression of hcp -UH 7 below 27(1) GPa, we observe decomposition into hcp -UH 5 , which subsequently further dehydrogenates to U 4 H 15 below 12(1) GPa. The U 4 H 15 compound, analogous to the well-known Th 4 H 15 , is recoverable to ambient pressure and temperature, and slowly oxidizes over the timescale of hours. Whilst all compounds are metallic, electrical resistance measurements demonstrate an absence of superconductivity upon cooling to 3 K in U 4 H 15 , hcp -UH 5 , and hcp -UH 7 , and to 7 K in fcc -UH 8 .

title: A Fast Solver of Collocation Method for a Three-Dimensional Bond-Based Linear Peridynamic Model
abstractText: The peridynamic (PD) theory tends to provide a better description than the classical continuum mechanics theory in the context of long-range forces or discontinuities. However, due to the nonlocal properties of PD models, the numerical methods employed in these models yield stiffness matrices with very complicated structures, especially for three-dimensional problems. Fast algorithms usually require the computational domain to be rectangular in two space dimensions and cuboidal in three space dimensions to ensure that the resulting stiffness matrices have a Toeplitz-like structure. In this work, we construct an accurate and efficient solver of the collocation method for a three-dimensional bond-based linear PD model defined on a relatively general geometry. The discretization for PD models on cubic domains by the collocation method can lead to Block-Block-Toeplitz-Toeplitz-Block-Block-Toeplitz-Toeplitz-Block-Block (B-BTTB-BTTB-B) matrices. Based on this special structure, we optimize the computational work of the traditional solver from \(O(N^3)\) to \(O(N^2\log N)\) and reduce the memory requirement of the traditional solver from \(O(N^2)\) to \(O(N)\), where \(N\) is the number of spatial unknowns. More importantly, the fast method remains applicable to non-cuboidal geometries via domain extension into matching cubic areas and then carefully handling the nodes in the extended domains. Numerical experiments are performed to show the accuracy and efficiency of the proposed method.

Emplacement of volcaniclastic mass flows during the 2023 eruption of Shishaldin Volcano, Alaska
abstractText: Abstract Eruption-caused volcaniclastic mass flows were a significant feature of the four-month-long 2023 eruption of Shishaldin Volcano in Alaska. The volcano supports a nearly continuous cover of glacier ice and snow on the flanks of its upper edifice, and the emplacement of pyroclastic density currents over this snow and ice cover led to the generation of meltwater and lahars. Pyroclastic density currents that formed during the eruption were long and narrow in map view and did not develop marginal levees. Although the upper part of the Shishaldin Volcano cone is very steep (> 30 degrees), pyroclastic density currents typically travelled less than 2 km. These limited-runout flows resulted from low-level column collapse on all flanks of the volcano, but primarily on the north flank. A few episodes of lava fountaining in the summit crater resulted in the formation of small, unstable mounds of spatter and agglutinate. The mounds occasionally collapsed, forming hot, granular, incandescent flows. Pyroclastic density currents formed by all mechanisms interacted with snow and ice on the edifice to produce lahars. The pyroclastic density currents and lahars that formed throughout the 2023 eruption were similar to the eruptive products generated by previous historical eruptions of Shishaldin Volcano.

title: Deep phenotyping in medical genetics and genomics: a comprehensive overview
abstractText: Abstract Deep phenotyping, the systematic, quantitative assessment of macro- and micro-level phenotypes, is pivotal to precision medicine. Although genomics has advanced rapidly, incomplete phenotypic data limit medical insights and research. This review starts from tracing the evolution of deep phenotyping, highlighting standardized terminologies (HPO), advanced technologies (wearable sensors, imaging, PheWAS, AI-assisted methods), procedural frameworks, and large-scale databases. By integrating these resources, deep phenotyping clarifies disease heterogeneity, refines genotype–phenotype correlations, and identifies novel biomarkers—enhancing diagnostic accuracy via phenotype-driven approaches and reanalysis. Moreover, deep phenotyping underpins precision medicine by enabling robust disease stratification, personalized clinical care, and biomarker-driven trials. Besides these, it aids disease prevention, refines prognostic prediction, and supports lifespan-based strategies from pregnancy to aging. Emerging fields such as xenotransplantation illustrate its capacity to achieve precision medicine. We also introduce global perspectives on implementing deep phenotyping across diverse settings, illustrating its adaptability and clinical impact. Finally, we propose a flexible, three-module strategy integrating study scope, data acquisition, and analytic methods to guide future research of deep phenotyping. This review underscores deep phenotyping’s transformative potential to elevate diagnostics, inform targeted therapies, and optimize patient outcomes, heralding a new era in medical genetics and genomics.

abstractText: ABSTRACT Traditional dance in extracurricular activities serves not only as a means of developing artistic skills but also provides opportunities for students to become acquainted with their regional cultural heritage. However, the implementation of learning strategies for specific traditional dances at the junior high school level requires further contextual investigation. This study aims to examine the learning strategies employed in teaching Pagar Pengantin Dance through extracurricular dance activities at SMP Negeri 02 Belitang, focusing on planning, implementation, evaluation, and learning challenges. The study employed a descriptive qualitative approach with a case study design. The informants consisted of the extracurricular dance instructor as the primary informant and participating students as supporting informants. Data were collected through moderate participant observation, semi-structured interviews, and documentation, then examined through technique and source triangulation and analyzed using the Miles and Huberman model. The findings indicate that planning involved scheduling practice sessions, recording attendance, organizing learning materials progressively, and preparing equipment. Learning activities included warm-ups, demonstrations, direct practice, group exercises, and corrective feedback. Evaluation was based on observations of movement accuracy, rhythm, expression, group coordination, and prop usage, without a scored assessment instrument. Limited props constituted a major obstacle during practice. This study provides an overview of traditional dance learning strategies that support dance skill development while introducing local cultural heritage in schools. title: Green and simple rrs spectroscopic strategy based on xanthene-based dye; Acid Red 51 for eletriptan quantification in pharmaceuticals and biological samples
abstractText: Abstract Eletriptan tablets are a targeted pharmaceutical agent that acts as an agonist for the 5-hydroxytryptamine1 receptor subclassification, mostly employed to alleviate acute migraine episodes. As a member of the triptan class, Eletriptan functions by constricting cerebral blood vessels and decreasing the release of chemicals that cause light and sound sensitivity, nausea, and headache discomfort. Its efficacy in alleviating migraine symptoms makes it a valuable option for individuals seeking rapid and effective relief. A sustainable, rapid, one-pot resonance Resonance Rayleigh Scattering spectrometric technique was created for estimating out Eletriptan in pharmaceutical tablets and biological matrices. Upon mixing Eletriptan with the fluorescent ligand Acid Red 51 in an acidic buffer, a marked increase in resonance Resonance Rayleigh Scattering intensity was immediately observed. This phenomenon was ascribed to the selective formation of an ion-pair complex between the cationic Eletriptan drug and the anionic dye, which amplified the Resonance Rayleigh Scattering signal through enhanced scattering interactions. The RRS intensity showed a straight-line connection with Eletriptan concentration between 50 and 1500 ng/mL, allowing for accurate measurement. Key experimental parameters, including pH, ligand concentration, and buffer volume, were systematically optimized to maximize the sensitivity of the Eletriptan –Acid Red 51 system. The method adhered to International Council for Harmonisation validation criteria, achieving detection and quantification limits of 15.7 ng/mL and 47.8 ng/mL, respectively. Effective implementation to pharmaceutical and biological samples confirmed the method’s accuracy and reproducibility, with recovery rates aligning with acceptable analytical standards. Notably, the approach minimizes solvent consumption and hazardous waste generation, aligning with green analytical principles. By integrating simplicity, environmental sustainability, and high sensitivity, this Resonance Rayleigh Scattering-based technique emerges as a robust alternative for routine analysis of Eletriptan in quality control and biomedical research.

title: Giải pháp thúc đẩy chuyển đổi kép tại Việt Nam
abstractText: Chuyển đổi kép, với sự kết hợp giữa chuyển đổi số và chuyển đổi xanh, đang trở thành xu hướng phát triển chiến lược của nhiều quốc gia trong bối cảnh biến đổi khí hậu và quá trình số hóa nền kinh tế diễn ra ngày càng sâu rộng. Nhiều quốc gia và tổ chức quốc tế đã coi chuyển đổi kép là nền tảng của mô hình tăng trưởng bền vững, trong đó chuyển đổi xanh đóng vai trò định hướng nhằm giảm phát thải carbon, sử dụng hiệu quả tài nguyên và thúc đẩy phát triển kinh tế tuần hoàn, còn chuyển đổi số đóng vai trò công cụ quan trọng giúp tối ưu hóa quản lý tài nguyên, nâng cao hiệu quả sản xuất và thúc đẩy đổi mới sáng tạo. Tại Việt Nam, chuyển đổi xanh và chuyển đổi số là hai trong bốn chuyển đổi đóng vai trò trung tâm trong quá trình chuyển đổi mô hình tăng trưởng, và đang được thúc đẩy mạnh mẽ thông qua các chiến lược quốc gia về chuyển đổi số và tăng trưởng xanh. Nghiên cứu dưới đây sử dụng kết hợp phương pháp định tính và định lượng, gồm tổng quan tài liệu, phân tích kinh nghiệm quốc tế, khảo sát thực tế doanh nghiệp và tham vấn chuyên gia để đánh giá quá trình thực hiện chuyển đổi kép tại Việt Nam. Large-Area Marine Surface Current Measurement Using Unmanned Aerial Vehicle-Based Optical Flow Mosaicking Without Ground Control Points
abstractText: Abstract Nearshore ocean currents are characterized by complex structures and spatial heterogeneity. Conventional measurement techniques are either inefficient or offer low spatial resolution, while image velocimetry (a low-cost, high-resolution method) is limited in marine applications due to the trade-off between large-area coverage and high resolution, as well as the lack of ground control points for calibration. To address these issues, this study proposes a current field mosaicking method. By maintaining the camera in constant-speed motion, the distance differences between consecutive image frames are converted into row offsets using the interframe time interval and image resolution, thereby expanding the velocimetry observation range through stitching. An adaptive thresholding method combining sun-glint identification and cropping is also developed. Results show that the picture range increases from 60 to 350 m, enabling large-area optical-flow velocimetry, and that the sun glint removal technique effectively reduces interference without additional quality degradation or artificial signals. This approach solves key constraints of image velocimetry in large-scale marine environments.

MicroRNA-1 and microRNA-499 as potential time-dependent biomarkers for the detection of early myocardial ischaemia
abstractText: Abstract Post-mortem diagnosis of ​ acute myocardial infarction (AMI) remains one of the major challenges in forensic pathology, as conventional macroscopic, histological and immunohistochemical techniques lack sufficient sensitivity within the first hour after onset of ischaemia. Using the established isolated-perfused rat heart model according to Langendorff, this study aimed to evaluate the feasibility and diagnostic potential of myocardial microRNA (miRNA) expression analysis for detecting very early ischaemic conditions. Myocardial expression patterns of four cardiac-enriched miRNAs (miRNA-1-3p, miRNA-133a-3p, miRNA-208a-3p and miRNA-499-5p) were investigated. After 30 min of ischaemia, distinct upregulation of miRNA-1 and miRNA-499 was observed in ischaemic myocardium. Following prolonged ischaemia of 240 min, expression levels of all four miRNAs declined in ischaemic myocardial tissue. These findings suggest an early, transient increase in selected cardiac-enriched miRNAs followed by a decrease with ongoing ischaemia, reflecting a dynamic, time-dependent regulation pattern. Our data demonstrate that myocardial miRNA alterations occur within 30 min of ischaemia. Specifically, we identified miRNA-1 and miRNA-499 as promising early indicators of acute ischemic myocardial injury. Thus, miRNA expression profiling may serve as a valuable adjunct to established forensic diagnostic approaches, particularly when survival times are short and conventional morphological methods reach their limits. Further validation in human post-mortem material is necessary to confirm the diagnostic applicability.

title: 炎症与脂质新型标志物WHR、NHR、NLR、RC、TyG在初发急性缺血性脑卒中患者的表达及临床意义
abstractText: 探讨炎症与脂质新型标志物WHR、NHR、NLR、RC、TyG在初发急性缺血性脑卒中患者（AIS）的表达及临床意义。方法 本研究纳入2023年6月-2025年6月于江苏省中医院就诊的321例AIS患者和287例健康体检者。收集两组基线资料和实验室指标，比较白细胞与高密度脂蛋白胆固醇比值（WHR）、中性粒细胞与高密度脂蛋白胆固醇比值（NHR）、血小板与高密度脂蛋白胆固醇比值 （PHR）、中性粒细胞与淋巴细胞比值（NLR）、残余胆固醇(RC)、甘油三酯-葡萄糖指数(TyG)、胆固醇-高密度脂蛋白-葡萄糖指数(CHG index)等炎症与脂质新型标志物的差异。利用Logistic回归分析上述指标与AIS发病之间的关系及其与NIHSS评分的相关性，最后利用受试者工作特征曲线(ROC)评估以上指标单独及联合预测AIS的诊断效能。结果 与健康对照组比较，AIS组WHR、NHR、PHR、RC、TyG、FBG、WBC、NEU、NLR显著升高 (P < 0.05)。单因素Logistic回归分析显示，上述指标均为AIS的危险因素。排除混杂因素的干扰后，HDL-C (OR=0.07 , P=0.03)、WHR (OR=7.41, P=0.03)、NHR (OR=0.05, P=0.02)、RC (OR=5.87, P<0.01)、FBG (OR=1.79 , P<0.01)、TyG指数 (OR=0.38, P=0.002)与NLR (OR=3.83, P=0.002)仍是AIS患者的独立危险因素。Spearman相关性分析显示，NLR和NHR与NIHSS评分成正相关（P<0.05），而RC水平与NIHSS评分成负相关（P<0.05）。ROC分析结果显示，WHR、NHR、NLR、RC、TyG五个指标对AIS患者均有较高的诊断价值，其中NLR诊断特异性最高为0.90，NHR诊断敏感最高为0.87。进一步将五个指标联合诊断，其ROC曲线下面积(AUC)高达0.85。结论 AIS患者WHR、NHR、NLR、RC、TyG水平升高，是AIS的独立危险因素。而且，NLR、NHR水平与AIS病情严重程度相关，可作为AIS发生及病情评估的预测因素之一。

title: Predictive Model for Ammonia Absorption Capacity of Deep Eutectic Solvents Using Rough Set Theory
abstractText: Abstract The direct emission of ammonia (NH 3 ) into the atmosphere from process waste gas streams brings environmental and health risks. This can be mitigated through absorption using solvents. Deep eutectic solvents (DES) were introduced as green absorption solvents with advantages including wide liquid range, high thermal stability and simple synthesis. Experimental studies indicate that NH₃ absorption capacity improves with acidic DES, higher hydrogen bond donor (HBD) to hydrogen bond acceptor (HBA) ratio, controlled water content, lower temperature and higher pressure. However, the exhaustive number of possible DES combinations formed by varying HBAs, HBDs, molar ratio and water content, makes it difficult to evaluate each combination experimentally. This combinatorial complexity together with the influence of process conditions, makes determining the optimal ranges of these variables through trial-and-error experiments resource-intensive and time-consuming. While predictive modelling offers a solution, most existing models are black-box approaches that lack interpretability, providing limited insights into how each variable affects NH 3 absorption performance. This limits their application in guiding solvent and process design. Therefore, this work developed an interpretable predictive model for NH 3 absorption in DES using rough set machine learning (RSML). RSML applies rough set theory (RST) to generate interpretable results by analysing indiscernibility relations within large datasets. Data on DES properties and process conditions affecting NH 3 absorption capacity were collected for model development. Decision rules with high certainty (> 80%) were analysed. Results revealed that acidic HBDs (i.e. phenols), lower temperatures (< 338 K), higher pressures (> 101.3 kPa) and controlled water content (0.025–0.075 wt%) enhance NH 3 absorption capacity.

title: Comparación de la prolongación analgésica con dexmedetomidina a dosis de 25 vs 50 mcg como adyuvante a ropivacaína en bloqueo supraclavicular para cirugía de antebrazo en el Centenario Hospital Miguel Hidalgo
abstractText: Perineural dexmedetomidine prolongs brachial plexus block analgesia, but the optimal dose remains under discussion. The aim was to compare the duration of postoperative analgesia with 50 µg versus 25 µg of dexmedetomidine as an adjuvant to 0.5% ropivacaine in ultrasound-guided supraclavicular block. A parallel-group randomised clinical trial was conducted at Centenario Hospital Miguel Hidalgo, Aguascalientes, Mexico, between July and December 2025. Twenty-six adults with ASA physical status I to III scheduled for elective surgery were allocated to 18 mL of 0.5% ropivacaine plus 25 µg (n = 13) or 50 µg (n = 13) of dexmedetomidine. The primary outcome was time to first rescue analgesia; secondary outcomes were 24-hour morphine consumption, motor block duration and adverse events. All participants completed follow-up. Time to first rescue was 15.81 ± 1.29 hours with 50 µg and 11.55 ± 1.17 hours with 25 µg (difference: 4.26 hours; 95% CI: 3.26 to 5.26; p < .001). Morphine consumption fell from 12.00 to 6.15 mg (difference: −5.85 mg; 95% CI: −7.86 to −3.84), and motor block was prolonged by 2.96 hours (95% CI: 2.14 to 3.78). Sedation (30.8% vs. 7.7%) and bradycardia (15.4% vs. 7.7%) were more frequent with 50 µg, without significant differences. It was concluded that 50 µg prolonged analgesia and reduced opioid consumption, at the cost of longer motor block; the sample size does not rule out more adverse effects.

abstractText: Student public transportation often experiences inefficiency due to suboptimal routes and schedules. This study aims to determine more efficient student transportation routes and schedules using the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) method. This method is applied to minimize travel time and distance while considering fleet capacity and operational constraints. Simulation results show that PSO can significantly improve objective values, resulting in more organized and efficient routes and departure schedules. This study concludes that PSO is an effective optimization approach for student transportation planning. The contribution of this research is to provide a computational optimization model that can be used as a basis for developing a more adaptive transportation scheduling system. In addition, the optimization model developed is capable of integrating operational variables such as departure sequence, passenger readiness, and passenger distribution patterns on each bus to produce more realistic solutions. The application of PSO in the simulation shows that this algorithm can eliminate hard constraints while reducing soft constraints, reflecting an increase in overall system efficiency. The departure schedule obtained is also more stable with consistent headways, thereby reducing student waiting times and increasing fleet utilization.

title: Mapping Agricultural Drought-Prone Areas in Malang Regency Using MODIS and CHIRPS Data for Mitigation Planning
abstractText: Agricultural drought is a recurring threat to food production in Malang Regency, yet monitoring at the subdistrict level is still hampered by the scarcity of rain gauges. This study aimed to map the frequency and spatial distribution of agricultural drought, examine its trends over 2001–2025, and assess how cropland vegetation responds to rainfall deficits across the 33 subdistricts of Malang Regency. Vegetation condition was expressed by the Vegetation Condition Index (VCI) derived from 250 m MODIS MOD13Q1 NDVI over cropland, while meteorological drought was expressed by the Standardized Precipitation Index (SPI) at 1, 3, and 6 month scales computed from CHIRPS rainfall. All images were processed in Google Earth Engine and analysed in R using the Mann–Kendall test, Sen’s slope, and Spearman correlation. Agricultural drought tended to decline: the number of drought months decreased by 0.088 months per year and dry-season VCI increased by 0.96 per year, both statistically significant, whereas the annual rainfall trend was not significant. The year 2003 was the driest on record. Agricultural drought frequency ranged from 4.1 to 22.1% among subdistricts and was not related to rainfall, suggesting that local land and water management conditions play a role; the highest frequencies occurred in Kalipare, Donomulyo, Gedangan, and Pujon. Vegetation responded to rainfall deficits within the same month, with weaker responses in subdistricts served by irrigation networks. The interannual correlation between VCI and SPI-3 remained strong after detrending (ρ = 0.833), indicating that VCI is suitable for subdistrict-level drought monitoring and for identifying priority areas for further mitigation planning.

title: Autapse-inspired neuromorphic hardware with synapse–neuron integration for bidirectional feedback control
abstractText: Abstract Establishing autonomous and energy-efficient feedback control at the hardware level remains challenging because conventional systems rely on centralized processing and continuous external computation, increasing energy consumption and system complexity. Here we show a neuromorphic autapse-inspired system that enables localized and bidirectional feedback control, using thermoregulation as a representative application. An autapse is a self-synaptic connection in which a neuron feeds its output back to its own synaptic input, enabling intrinsic feedback modulation. The system integrates a solid electrolyte-based synaptic transistor capable of multiplexing multiple inputs and a bidirectional leaky integrate-and-fire artificial neuron. By feeding the neuronal output back to an additional synaptic gate, excitatory and inhibitory feedback loops are realized within a compact architecture. Using an artificial thermoregulation platform, temperature-dependent inputs bidirectionally modulate neuronal firing frequency, demonstrating biologically inspired feedback control with a compact set of neuromorphic devices for autonomous and energy-efficient systems.

title: BOPPPS教学模式下中西医结合眼科学课程思政教学的探索与实践
abstractText: 摘要：中西医结合眼科学是中西医临床医学专业核心临床课程，兼具理论性与实践性，课程中蕴含丰厚的中医药文化内涵、医德医风与职业精神等思政教育资源。为提升课程教学质量，达成专业教学与思政教育深度融合，本文以 BOPPPS 教学模式为框架，选取老年性白内障章节作为教学案例，依托金陵洪氏眼科非物质文化遗产教学资源，从课程思政元素挖掘、课堂教学设计实施、多元教学评价构建以及教学反思总结等维度开展教学改革实践。将中医药文化自信、大医精诚、守正创新、社会责任等思政要点嵌入导言、学习目标、前测、参与式学习、后测、总结各教学环节，实现知识传授、能力培养与价值塑造三位一体。教学实践证实，BOPPPS 教学模式可有效提升学生课堂参与度与学习内驱力，助力中西医结合临床思维构建；把中医眼科非遗资源引入课堂教学，能够强化学生中医药文化自信、职业认同感与社会担当意识，可为中西医结合眼科学课程思政建设提供实践参考。

title: Biogenic Carboxylation of Granular Activated Carbon via Citrus aurantiifolia Juice for Fluoride Removal
abstractText: Abstract Excess fluoride (F⁻) in potable water matrices poses a critical global public health threat, including endemic dental and skeletal fluorosis across vulnerable populations. Conventional defluoridation techniques like electrocoagulation and ion exchange are frequently constrained by prohibitive operational cost, complex synthesis protocols, and infrastructure limitations in decentralized settings. Herein, we demonstrate a surface functionalization approach for granular activated carbon (GAC) using raw Citrus aurantiifolia (lime) juice as a naturally derived, citric-acid-rich modifying agent. The procedure employs food-grade, non-hazardous materials as an alternative to conventional analytical-grade chemical reagents. Following modification, surface carboxyl-group concentrations increased from 1.26 mmol/g for GAC to 1.98 mmol/g for lime-modified GAC (LGAC) and 1.85 mmol/g for citric acid modified GAC (CAGAC). XPS showed a corresponding increase in surface oxygen content, from 5.92 at% (GAC) to 12.29 at% (CAGAC) and 21.28 at% (LGAC), with distinct C–O and O–C = O contributions on LGAC. Despite a 47% reduction in BET surface area, LGAC exhibited an empirical maximum monolayer adsorption capacity (q max ) of 1.63 mg/g, making its thermodynamic performance statistically identical ( p > 0.05) to CAGAC (1.65 mg/g) and yielding > 85% enhancement over unmodified GAC (0.88 mg/g). Geochemical speciation modeling (PHREEQC) further elucidated a possible immobilization pathway in LGAC via localized aqueous metal-F⁻ complexation dynamics, which were absent in synthetic CAGAC systems. Robust sorption kinetics were maintained across environmentally pertinent pH range (pH 4.0–8.0) and under competitive ionic strength conditions with co-existing groundwater anions. Fixed-bed continuous-flow experiments with multicomponent synthetic groundwater showed that LGAC’s column capacity was 26% higher than that of GAC and ~ 89% of that of CAGAC. These findings validate Citrus aurantiifolia juice as a food-grade, bio-derived modifier, thereby lowering synthesis barriers and offering a practical approach for point-of-use (POU) defluoridation in resource-constrained settings.

title: New employee recruitment selection decision support system using the web-based VIKOR method (Case Study: Gatarego II)
abstractText: Human resource needs are crucial for supporting a company's sustainability and progress. Appropriate workforce planning and recruitment are essential for objective selection and the production of qualified employees. However, manual employee selection processes can potentially lead to subjectivity and suboptimal decision-making. This study aims to design and build a decision support system that can assist the Human Resources (HR) department in selecting prospective employees more effectively and structuredly, and provide suitability recommendations based on predetermined criteria. The method used in this study is the VlseKriterijumska Optimizacija I Kompromisno Resenje (VIKOR) system, which uses four main criteria: written tests, interviews, skills, and experience. The system was developed web-based to facilitate data access and management, and allows for adjustment of criteria and assessment weights as needed. The system's testing results on four respondents from each division showed a score of 0.47, which is considered good. This indicates that the system is capable of facilitating the evaluation process and providing alternative decisions in the selection of prospective employees. Based on these results, it can be concluded that the developed VIKOR-based decision support system is capable of increasing the effectiveness and objectivity of the employee selection process and providing effective support for decision-making.

title: Perencanaan Geometrik Jalan pada Kawasan Ekonomi Khusus Bitung
abstractText: Kawasan Ekonomi Khusus (KEK) Bitung di Provinsi Sulawesi Utara merupakan kawasan strategis nasional yang membutuhkan dukungan infrastruktur jalan yang memadai untuk mengakomodasi aktivitas industri, logistik, dan distribusi barang. Penelitian ini bertujuan menganalisis kondisi topografi lokasi penelitian, merencanakan alinyemen horizontal dan vertikal, menentukan panjang trase jalan, serta menghitung volume galian dan timbunan pada perencanaan jalan baru di kawasan tersebut. Metode yang digunakan adalah metode survei kuantitatif yang mengacu pada Pedoman Desain Geometrik Jalan (PDGJ) 2021, dengan pengambilan data primer menggunakan Total Station, serta pengolahan data menggunakan perangkat lunak AutoCAD Civil 3D. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan kondisi topografi lokasi dominan datar dengan kelandaian di bawah 10%. Trase jalan rencana memiliki panjang 1.225 m dengan kecepatan rencana 40 km/jam. Alinyemen horizontal terdiri atas dua tikungan tipe full circle dengan jari-jari rencana 300 m dan 250 m, panjang lengkung masing-masing 85,203 m dan 65,574 m, serta superelevasi 2,94%. Alinyemen vertikal terdiri atas dua lengkung vertikal, cekung dan cembung, dengan panjang 270,00 m dan 278,74 m serta kelandaian memanjang berkisar antara -3,33% hingga -4,67%. Volume galian yang dihasilkan sebesar 226.057,68 m3 dan volume timbunan sebesar 36.550,30 m3. Hasil perencanaan ini telah memenuhi persyaratan teknis PDGJ 2021 dan dapat menjadi acuan pengembangan jaringan jalan pada KEK Bitung.

title: Dữ liệu, thể chế và tăng trưởng kinh tế: Tổng quan lý thuyết có cấu trúc và hàm ý chính sách cho Việt Nam
abstractText: Việc dữ liệu ngày càng được khai thác trong sản xuất và quản lý không tự động chuyển thành năng suất hoặc tăng trưởng; giá trị kinh tế của dữ liệu còn phụ thuộc vào khả năng biến dữ liệu thành thông tin và vào các quy tắc chi phối quyền, tiếp cận, chia sẻ, cạnh tranh, riêng tư và niềm tin. Bài viết nhằm hệ thống hóa các cơ chế này và xác định những hàm ý phù hợp với bối cảnh Việt Nam thông qua một tổng quan lý thuyết có cấu trúc. Kết quả tổng hợp chỉ ra hai kênh liên kết: kênh thông tin - phân bổ giúp giảm bất định và nâng chất lượng quyết định; kênh năng suất - đổi mới hỗ trợ học hỏi và tối ưu hóa quy trình. Thể chế dữ liệu quyết định mức độ hai kênh được hiện thực hóa và cách lợi ích, chi phí được phân bổ. Từ đó, bài viết xác định ba ưu tiên có điều kiện cho Việt Nam: hoàn thiện quản trị và niềm tin dữ liệu; phát triển hạ tầng liên thông cùng cơ chế tiếp cận, chia sẻ theo rủi ro; tăng cường giám sát cạnh tranh và năng lực khai thác. Giá trị của bài viết nằm ở việc nối các cơ chế lý thuyết với một khung phân tích và lộ trình chính sách có thể theo dõi, không phải ở việc khẳng định tác động nhân quả.

title: A Binuclear Ruthenium–Phenformin Compound: Synthesis, Characterization, and Inhibition of the DHFR Enzyme
abstractText: Abstract The Ru-phenformin compound Ru80 was synthesized and characterized by NMR and UV/Vis spectroscopies, as well as by SCXRD, HRMS, and elemental analysis. Enzymatic assays confirm that Ru80 is effective in reducing the catalytic activity of DHFR enzyme. Ru80 retains its inhibitory activity under macromolecularly crowded conditions designed to mimic cellular environments, requiring slightly higher concentrations to achieve comparable levels of inhibition. Thermodynamic analysis demonstrates that Ru80 significantly weakens the binding affinity of NADPH cofactor to DHFR enzyme. Enzyme kinetic analysis also suggests a mixed (noncompetitive) inhibition mechanism where Ru80 binds to the free enzyme as well as the enzyme substrate complex. Ru80 binds to DHFR enzyme in a time-dependent and nonspecific manner.

title: A hidden jet emission component revealed by the anomalous X-ray low state of 1ES 0229+200
abstractText: Abstract In August 2021, simultaneous Swift-XRT and NuSTAR observations caught the extreme high-synchrotron-peaked BL Lac object 1ES 0229+200 in an exceptionally faint X-ray state. The spectrum was concave, showing tentative hardening above ∼ 25 keV. We investigate three representative interpretations within a common decelerating-jet framework: a one-zone hybrid electron–proton syn-chrotron model (Model A), and external-Compton (EC) and pure synchrotron self-Compton (SSC) realizations of a two-zone leptonic model (Model B). All three reproduce the simultaneous X-ray spectrum. In Model A, electron synchrotron emission accounts for the soft X-rays, while proton synchrotron emission produces the hard component. In both realizations of Model B, a compact inner zone produces the hard component through EC or SSC emission, while an outer zone approximately describes the historical broadband emission. The three solutions therefore lead to the same observational inference: the low state reveals an additional radiative component that is normally hidden beneath the dominant soft-X-ray continuum. The present data do not determine whether this component arises from a second particle population in one zone or from a distinct dissipation region. Simultaneous hard-X-ray, MeV, GeV, and VHE observations will distinguish these possibilities.

title: EATING BEHAVIOR ISSUES, CONSTIPATION SYMPTOM SCORES, AND HYPERACTIVITY IN CHILDREN WITH AUTISM SPECTRUM DISORDER: A STATISTICAL MEDIATION ANALYSIS
abstractText: Children with autism spectrum disorder often experience eating behavior issues and constipation symptoms thought to relate to hyperactivity via the microbiota-gut-brain axis. This study analyzed constipation symptom scores as a statistical mediator between eating behavior issues and hyperactivity in children aged 4–12 years. A cross-sectional correlational design involved parents or guardians of 66 children in five special schools in Bandung City, selected by total sampling. Measures were the Brief Autism Mealtime Behavior Inventory, the GSRS constipation domain, and the ABC hyperactivity subscale, analyzed with Spearman correlation and bootstrap mediation (5,000 samples, 95% CI). All three correlated positively and significantly: eating behavior–constipation (rho = 0.339; p = 0.005), eating behavior–hyperactivity (rho = 0.293; p = 0.017), and constipation–hyperactivity (rho = 0.385; p = 0.001). In the main model the indirect effect was significant (B = 0.0775; 95% CI 0.0050–0.1872); the direct effect was borderline (p = 0.048). After controlling for ADHD status, age, and sex, the indirect effect remained significant (B = 0.0637; 95% CI 0.0073–0.1468) while the direct effect did not (p = 0.195), which does not establish the absence of a direct pathway. Monitoring gastrointestinal status is recommended within holistic nursing assessment, not as a proven intervention.

title: Pemeriksaan Kelaikan Fungsi Bangunan Hotel Metland Maron Aspek Struktural dan Arsitektural
abstractText: Pertumbuhan pembangunan gedung di Indonesia menuntut setiap bangunan memenuhi persyaratan kelaikan fungsi yang mencakup aspek keselamatan, kesehatan, kenyamanan, dan kemudahan sesuai dengan Peraturan Pemerintah Nomor 16 Tahun 2021. Hotel sebagai bangunan publik memerlukan evaluasi berkala untuk memastikan kondisi struktur dan arsitektural tetap memenuhi standar yang berlaku selama masa layan bangunan. Penelitian ini bertujuan mengevaluasi kelaikan fungsi Bangunan Hotel Metland Maron Tomohon melalui pemeriksaan aspek struktural dan arsitektural. Metode penelitian yang digunakan adalah metode deskriptif kuantitatif dengan pengumpulan data melalui observasi lapangan, studi dokumen, pemodelan struktur menggunakan ETABS, pengujian *Non-Destructive Test (NDT)* menggunakan *Concrete Hammer Test*, serta pengujian arsitektural berupa pengukuran tingkat pencahayaan dan kebisingan yang mengacu pada Standar Nasional Indonesia (SNI) dan peraturan yang berlaku. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan bahwa elemen struktur utama bangunan memiliki kondisi yang baik berdasarkan hasil Hammer Test dan analisis struktur menggunakan ETABS, sehingga mampu memenuhi persyaratan keamanan struktur. Hasil pengujian pencahayaan dan kebisingan pada sebagian besar ruang juga menunjukkan nilai yang berada dalam batas standar yang dipersyaratkan. Secara keseluruhan, Hotel Metland Maron dinyatakan memenuhi persyaratan kelaikan fungsi pada aspek struktural dan arsitektural serta masih layak digunakan sebagai bangunan hotel dengan tetap memperhatikan pemeliharaan dan evaluasi berkala terhadap kondisi bangunan.

Growing Degree Days to Estimate Crop Development Coefficient in Potato at North Mexico
abstractText: Air temperature has increased due to global warming, growing degree days (GDD) use the air temperature for its estimation. Among the methods for estimating GDD, the exponential, physiological, residual, and modified sine methods are significantly similar, but the gradual method is the best option to estimate GDD. Climate variation prompts us to have climate-based models that use GDD to create crop development model. With five agroclimatic stations in locations were sowing potato. With agroclimatic stations estimate Eto is the reference evapotranspiration mm/day and ETr is the crop water consumption in the soil with water content sensor in kPa, gravimetric water content (Pw), with soil’s bulk density to obtain the volumetric content (θ) with the depth of soil water sensor at two depths (15 and 30 cm) to estimate daily consumption in mm/day. If kc = Etr/Eto, the kc is related daily to GDD, the best model estimated was third-degree models with R2 values greater than 0.90, the estimation of GDD with the models are highly significant. This contribution will allow us to estimate the crop coefficient (kc) by measuring temperature and relating it to the reference evapotranspiration (ETo) from agroclimatic stations, in order to determine the water consumption of the potato crop. Therefore, the models for every agroclimatic stations are suitable for climate variation.

Machine Learning-Based Classification of Microplastics Using Spectral Data for Environmental Monitoring
abstractText: Accurate classification of microplastic particles is important for developing automated analytical methods. This study investigates machine-learning-based classification of five standard microplastic polymers—polyethylene (PE), polyethylene terephthalate (PET), polypropylene (PP), polystyrene (PS), and polyvinyl chloride (PVC)—using experimentally acquired laser-induced fluorescence (LIF) spectra. A measurement system combining 266 nm laser excitation, hydrodynamic focusing, and spectroscopic detection was used to collect 1,300 fluorescence spectra. Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Random Forest (RF) classifiers were evaluated using full-spectrum data containing 2,047 features and a restricted wavelength interval of 275–600 nm containing 553 features. In the stratified 80:20 hold-out evaluation, SVM and RF achieved accuracies of 98.46% and 98.08%, respectively. Both classifiers maintained 98.08% accuracy using the restricted spectral interval. Seven-fold Leave-One-Day-Out (LODO) cross-validation was additionally performed to assess acquisition-day variability. The LODO accuracies ranged from 96.46% for SVM without L2 normalization to 99.08% for L2-normalized RF, with the latter achieving 95.00% accuracy on its weakest acquisition day. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of machine-learning-based classification using experimentally acquired LIF spectra under controlled laboratory conditions. However, further validation using independently sourced and environmentally representative microplastic samples is necessary to establish broader applicability.

title: Convergence of the Random Batch Method for Interacting Particle Systems Driven by Fractional Brownian Motion
abstractText: In this paper, the random batch method for solving interacting particle systems driven by fractional Brownian motion with Hurst parameter $H ∈ (0,1)$ is introduced. The random batch method is an efficient technique that significantly reduces the computational cost of simulating interacting particle systems. A detailed error analysis of the method is conducted, accompanied by rigorous derivations of upper bounds for these errors. Numerical experiments are performed to verify the theoretical results, demonstrating the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed method.

Contamination and laundering of firefighter undergarments following wildland fire exposure
abstractText: Background Undergarments worn beneath protective clothing during bushfire operations may retain smoke-related contaminants, potentially exposing firefighters even after firefighting activities have ended. Aims We investigated contamination of firefighter undergarments, the effectiveness of laundering and the potential for contamination to transfer between wash loads. Methods Cotton undergarments worn during bushfire and prescribed burn operations in Western Australia were analysed using Fourier transform infrared spectroscopy, with formaldehyde as the primary marker of contamination. We assessed warm (40°C, n = 15) and cold (~20°C, n = 7) washing, repeat laundering and contamination transfer to clean garments washed after contaminated loads, with or without an intervening empty hot wash cycle. Key results Exposed undergarments released measurable formaldehyde. Warm washing reduced mean formaldehyde concentrations from 0.12 to 0.01 parts per million (ppm), a reduction of 91%, whereas cold washing reduced concentrations from 0.21 to 0.06 ppm (71%). Rewashing the cold-washed garments at 40°C produced no statistically significant further reduction. Clean garments washed after contaminated loads showed increased contamination, whereas an intervening empty hot wash reduced concentrations to near-baseline levels. Conclusions Laundering substantially reduced formaldehyde off-gassing, but contamination could transfer between loads. Implications Empty hot wash cycles may help limit cross-contamination when laundering firefighter clothing.

Ultra-narrow-gate single-electron transistors based on crossed graphene nanoribbons
abstractText: Abstract Graphene nanoribbons (GNRs) are promising candidates for next-generation nanoelectronics owing to their width-dependent bandgaps and high carrier mobility. However, integrating ultra-narrow GNRs into well-defined device architectures with local electrostatic control remains challenging. Here, we demonstrate a dual-gate single-electron transistor (SET) device consisting of two spatially isolated, in-situ encapsulated GNRs grown within hexagonal boron nitride (hBN) flakes, where one GNR serves as the transport channel and the other as an ultra-narrow local top gate, enabling nanoscale electrostatic modulation. Room-temperature transport measurements show that the GNR channel operates as a field-effect transistor with an on/off ratio of ${\sim} 2 \times 10^{3}$ ∼ 2 × 10 3 and a subthreshold swing of 150 mV⋅dec −1 under back-gate control, while the GNR top gate provides comparable electrostatic control despite its much shorter gate length, validating its role as an efficient local gate. At 15 K, the device exhibits clear single-electron transport characteristics, including periodic Coulomb blockade (CB) oscillations and gate-tunable Coulomb diamonds. Upon tuning the gate voltages, the transport behavior evolves continuously from Coulomb blockade to Fabry–Pérot interference, revealing a crossover from localized charge transport to coherent interference governed by the locally modulated potential landscape. Our results establish in-situ encapsulated GNRs as a promising platform for carbon-based nanoelectronics and for exploring one-dimensional quantum transport in locally gated nanostructures.

Physicochemical and Antioxidant Variability in Fermented Beans of 40 Cocoa Clones Under Evaluation in the Brazilian Amazon
abstractText: Cocoa breeding programs need comparative data on bean composition to support clone selection, yet few studies evaluate many genotypes simultaneously under the same conditions. This study characterized the physicochemical composition and antioxidant capacity of fermented beans from 40 cocoa clones grown at a single site in Uruará, Pará State, Brazilian Amazon, as part of the Teste de Clones Brasil (TCB) breeding program. Moisture, ash, lipids, proteins, carbohydrates, pH, titratable acidity, total polyphenols, and antioxidant capacity (ORAC) were determined, and univariate and multivariate analyses were applied to assess variability and group clones by compositional profile. All parameters differed significantly among clones, suggesting a major genotypic influence on bean composition under homogeneous cultivation and post-harvest conditions. Lipid content ranged from 9.69 g/100 g DM (TCB-144) to 45.09 g/100 g DM (TCB-126), which also had the highest protein content (21.62 g/100 g DM); total polyphenols ranged from 0.18 to 1.70 g GAE/100 g DM (highest in TCB-25); and ORAC ranged from 21.11 to 392.77 µmol TE/g (highest in TCB-23). Principal component analysis (53.1% of the variance explained) and hierarchical clustering grouped the clones into three profiles: higher carbohydrate, lower lipid, and higher pH; balanced lipid, protein, and phenolic contents; and higher polyphenol contents with variable acidity and ORAC. Overall, compositional profiling provides a descriptive basis for clone selection and for guiding post-harvest management in cocoa breeding programs.

title: Penerapan Microlearning dalam Meningkatkan Literasi Digital dan Kemampuan Pemrograman: Studi Literatur Review
abstractText: Microlearning, the delivery of content in small units focused on a single learning goal, is increasingly used to build digital competence, yet evidence on its effects on digital literacy and programming ability has rarely been synthesised together. This study maps intervention characteristics, effectiveness, and implementation challenges. A systematic literature review following PRISMA 2020 covered journal articles, proceedings, and theses from 2016-2026, searched through open academic search on 16 October 2026. Of 48 records assessed, 14 primary studies were included (10 on digital literacy or competence, 4 on programming). All five controlled experimental studies favoured the Microlearning group; pre-post studies without comparison groups showed gains but are weak for causal inference. Recurring features were short single-concept units, interactivity with immediate feedback, and repeated access. Main barriers were infrastructure, teachers’ content-production skills, fragmented attention, and evidence quality. Microlearning appears promising as a complement to, not a replacement for, conventional instruction.

title: Desain Tebal Perkerasan dan Drainase pada Pembangunan Manado By Pass Morr 3 Tahap 4
abstractText: Pembangunan Jalan Manado By Pass MORR 3 Tahap 4 memerlukan perencanaan perkerasan dan drainase yang mampu mendukung beban lalu lintas serta mengendalikan limpasan air hujan agar umur pelayanan jalan tercapai. Penelitian ini bertujuan menentukan tebal perkerasan lentur berdasarkan Manual Desain Perkerasan Jalan (MDPJ) 2024 serta merancang dimensi saluran drainase berdasarkan analisis hidrologi. Metode penelitian menggunakan data lalu lintas harian rata-rata (LHR), nilai California Bearing Ratio (CBR), curah hujan maksimum tahunan, dan data topografi. Perencanaan perkerasan mengacu pada MDPJ 2024, sedangkan perencanaan drainase menggunakan analisis Log Pearson Tipe III, metode Mononobe, Metode Rasional, dan Persamaan Manning. Hasil penelitian menunjukkan beban lalu lintas kumulatif sebesar 154.234.315 ESA dengan umur rencana 40 tahun. Nilai CBR tanah dasar sebesar 0,90% mengharuskan penggunaan timbunan pilihan setebal 600 mm. Struktur perkerasan terdiri atas AC-WC 40 mm, AC-BC 60 mm, AC-Base 170 mm, CTB 150 mm, Lapis Pondasi Agregat Kelas B 150 mm, dan timbunan pilihan 600 mm. Analisis hidrologi menghasilkan debit rencana 4,24 m³/detik sehingga direncanakan saluran drainase trapesium yang mampu mengalirkan debit secara aman. Desain perkerasan dan drainase yang dihasilkan memenuhi kebutuhan lalu lintas dan kondisi hidrologi ruas Jalan Manado By Pass MORR 3 Tahap 4.

EDUKASI DAN PEMERIKSAAN GOLONGAN DARAH PADA SISWA MADRASAH TSANAWIYAH SWASTA NAHDLATUL ULAMA MEDAN
abstractText: Pengetahuan mengenai golongan darah merupakan aspek penting dalam mendukung keselamatan individu, khususnya dalam kondisi gawat darurat yang membutuhkan tindakan transfusi darah. Namun, masih terdapat masyarakat yang belum mengetahui jenis golongan darahnya sehingga berpotensi menghambat proses penanganan medis ketika transfusi darah diperlukan. Selain itu, ketidakcocokan golongan darah antara pendonor dan penerima dapat menimbulkan reaksi transfusi yang membahayakan keselamatan pasien. Kegiatan pengabdian kepada masyarakat ini bertujuan untuk meningkatkan pengetahuan dan kesadaran peserta didik mengenai pentingnya mengetahui golongan darah melalui pemeriksaan golongan darah. Kegiatan dilaksanakan pada tanggal 12 Februari 2026 di Madrasah Tsanawiyah Swasta NU Medan dengan sasaran siswa kelas VIII dan IX. Metode pelaksanaan meliputi pemeriksaan golongan darah menggunakan sistem ABO terhadap seluruh peserta yang mengikuti kegiatan. Sebanyak 47 siswa berpartisipasi dalam kegiatan ini. Hasil pemeriksaan menunjukkan bahwa golongan darah O merupakan jenis yang paling banyak ditemukan, yaitu 26 orang (55,3%), diikuti golongan darah B sebanyak 12 orang (25,5%), golongan darah A sebanyak 6 orang (12,8%), dan golongan darah AB sebanyak 3 orang (6,4%). Kegiatan ini memberikan kesempatan kepada siswa untuk mengetahui golongan darah masing-masing sebagai bentuk kesiapsiagaan dalam menghadapi kondisi kegawatdaruratan yang memerlukan transfusi darah. Pemeriksaan golongan darah sejak dini diharapkan dapat meningkatkan kesadaran akan pentingnya informasi golongan darah bagi keselamatan dan kesehatan. Kegiatan serupa direkomendasikan untuk dilaksanakan secara berkelanjutan oleh tenaga kesehatan di lingkungan masyarakat.

Cân đối tiết kiệm với đầu tư tại Việt Nam
abstractText: Bài viết phân tích thực trạng cân đối tiết kiệm và đầu tư tại Việt Nam, đặt trong bối cảnh nền kinh tế hướng tới mục tiêu tăng trưởng hai con số. Bằng cách tiếp cận chuỗi số liệu vĩ mô, nghiên cứu chỉ ra một rào cản cấu trúc dai dẳng: tiết kiệm nội địa liên tục thấp hơn so với nhu cầu đầu tư mở rộng từ năm 2005 đến nay. Khoảng trống về vốn này khiến nền kinh tế cần vận dụng dòng vốn từ bên ngoài và duy trì trạng thái nhập siêu kéo dài của khu vực kinh tế trong nước. Hệ lụy của sự mất cân đối này làm dâng cao mặt bằng lãi suất trung tính, gây áp lực thanh khoản lên hệ thống ngân hàng khi tỷ lệ tín dụng trên huy động liên tục vượt ngưỡng an toàn, đồng thời tạo rủi ro phân bổ sai lệch nguồn lực và kìm hãm đổi mới công nghệ. Nhằm tháo gỡ nút thắt, bài viết đề xuất các giải pháp chính sách, bao gồm gia tăng tổng tiết kiệm, nâng cao hiệu quả sử dụng vốn, và khơi thông kênh dẫn vốn nhằm dịch chuyển dòng tiền từ các tài sản trú ẩn truyền thống sang khu vực sản xuất thực.
